title: Close the store before removing the temporary home in the ledger view-delta and custody test fixtures
outcome: Close the store before removing the temporary home in the ledger view-delta and custody test fixtures
acceptance: In src/storage/work/task_sync/ledger/view/delta_tests.rs and src/storage/work/task_sync/ledger/custody_tests.rs, each Fixture's store is dropped before its TempHome, by field order or an explicit Drop.
The affected ledger view-delta and custody tests run on Windows without OS error 32 cleanup warnings.
